question: The COBOL language is suitable for:
solution:
The correct answer is__** business purposes**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• COBOL stands for Common Business-Oriented Language.
 
• COBOL is primarily used in business, finance, and administrative systems for companies and governments.
 
• The applications like those in the defence domain, insurance domain, etc. which require huge data processing make extensive use of COBOL.
 
• It is designed **to be easy to read and write, with a syntax that is similar to English, and is commonly used for tasks such as financial and accounting systems, data processing, and business communication.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History of Common Business-Oriented Language (COBOL)**

 
 
• Common Business-Oriented Language (COBOL) **is a programming language that was developed in the late 1950s** for business applications. It was designed to be easy to learn and use, and it quickly became the standard language for business applications.
 
• COBOL was developed **by a team of computer scientists led by Grace Hoppe**r, who was a pioneer in the field of computer programming. The language was based on Hopper's work on the UNIVAC I, which was one of the first commercial computers.
 
• COBOL was designed to be used for a wide range of business applications, including financial management, inventory control, and data processing. It was designed to be highly portable, meaning that it could be used on different types of computers without requiring significant modification.
 
• COBOL** became widely used in the 1960s and 1970**s, and it was used by many major corporations and government agencies. It was also used in the development of early computer systems, such as the Integrated Data Store (IDS), which was used by the US Air Force.
